integrity: The included standalone Python verifier reconstructs exact distances and simplices, checks 5420 free-face collapses and 751 integral unit pivots, and checks the fundamental-group reduction. Independent assessment has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the first five distinct Euclidean pair-distance thresholds of the specified unscaled 24-point rhombicuboctahedron. No claim concerning later thresholds, perturbation stability, other Archimedean solids, integral group representations, or uniqueness over unindexed literature.
title: First five Euclidean Rips stages of the rhombicuboctahedron
